description: Cause categories a service-review scorecard may record as the primary_driver behind a period's SLA-attainment figure. A config's primary_driver field carries exactly one slug from this list.

outlook_values.transient: The condition behind the figure is expected to clear without intervention (self-correcting).
outlook_values.structural: The condition persists until a corrective change is made.

escalated_review_capacity.label: Escalated (manual-evidence) review capacity
escalated_review_capacity.description: Disputes routed to manual-evidence (representment) review, constrained by dedicated reviewer capacity.

dispute_volume_surge.label: Inbound dispute volume surge
dispute_volume_surge.description: Elevated inbound dispute intake for the period relative to the trailing baseline.

network_rule_change.label: Card-network rule change
network_rule_change.description: A card-network mandate (representment window, reason-code, or evidence-format change) affecting handling.

upstream_processor_latency.label: Upstream processor latency
upstream_processor_latency.description: Latency in an upstream processor or acquirer feed the resolution workflow depends on.

merchant_data_quality.label: Merchant-supplied data quality
merchant_data_quality.description: Incomplete or malformed merchant-supplied evidence requiring rework.

seasonality.label: Seasonality
seasonality.description: A recurring calendar effect on dispute intake or resolution timelines.
